content:
Alex Rivera: Opening a case with AWS to request H100 (p5 family) quota in us-east-2 + EFA enablement for our Dedicated clusters. Also need ENI and EIP pool increases. Case created: 12345678901234

Priya Nair: Can you paste the case link and account ID? We need the billing owner on the ticket and justification for the TAM.

Samir Patel: Account: 012345678901. Added support plan contact (tam@redwood.example). AWS will likely ask for expected baseline and peak, and subnet info for validation.

Alex Rivera: Link (internal): https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case?caseId=12345678901234  Baseline: 6 p5.48xlarge initially, burst to 12. ENI per-instance required: 8. EIP/NAT pool target: 30. Justification: Dedicated inference clusters + NCCL training sharding, low-latency regional surface.

aws-support-bot: Support update (Case 12345678901234): Assigned to engineer J. Ochoa. Initial review ETA ~4 hours. Please reply with Subnet IDs, VPC ID, and expected AZ distribution.

Linh Tran: Quick note — our capacity planner originally called for us-east-1, but latency tests favor us-east-2 for the majority of our EU traffic through the new backbone. Confirming target region is us-east-2.

Alex Rivera: Confirmed — us-east-2. Requested to update the case region. Also asked AWS to enable EFA for the account/region and to whitelist the instance types for our launch templates.

Priya Nair: Added justification text: "Low-latency inference + intra-node NCCL comms for model parallel workloads. Will use EFA-enabled placement groups and custom launch templates. Requesting quota to cover initial Dedicated cluster plus burst capacity." AWS might request subnet-level details and security contact; Samir already added the TAM.

Samir Patel: AWS engineer replied: "We can proceed pending validation. Please provide Subnet IDs where you will launch, VPC security group overview, and expected ENI per-AZ. Also confirm whether you need EFA support enabled at account level or per-VPC"

Alex Rivera: Subnet IDs: subnet-0a1b2c3d subnet-0e2f3a4b (both private, us-east-2a/us-east-2b). VPC: vpc-0f9e8d7c6b5a4a3b2. Security groups: sg-0c9b8a7d (allow custom mgmt + NCCL ports).

Alex Rivera: CLI snippet for validation (paste to support if they ask):
```
aws ec2 describe-subnets --subnet-ids subnet-0a1b2c3d subnet-0e2f3a4b --region us-east-2
aws ec2 describe-vpcs --vpc-ids vpc-0f9e8d7c6b5a4a3b2 --region us-east-2
```

Priya Nair: I dropped the subnet IDs and the justification into the support console and requested escalation to the TAM. Also asked for a timeline for quota approval and EFA enablement. :rocket:

aws-support-bot: Support update (Case 12345678901234): Engineer updated notes; escalation to TAM requested. AIM to provide approval within 48h after VPC validation. If urgent, submit justification document to TAM email.

oncall-sre: FYI — if AWS asks for VPC flow logs or a short security doc, we have a template. I can attach it to the ticket. Also confirm we will enable VPC endpoints for S3 to avoid public egress.

Alex Rivera: Good call. oncall-sre please attach the template if they ask. Priya, once we have approval, we'll trigger a small smoke run (2x p5) behind a canary placement-group. I'll coordinate the infra runbook.

Priya Nair: Also adding cost heads-up: H100 baseline (6 * p5.48xlarge) ~= $X/hr raw; monthly commit estimate ~ $Yk. I'll post a short cost breakdown to #finance after the ticket is green.

Samir Patel: AWS engineer note: "Pending subnet and VPC validation — if validated, quotas for p5 family (us-east-2) and ENI increases will be provisioned. EFA enablement may require additional verification by the network team; we've pinged them."

Alex Rivera: Thanks everyone — I'll update the thread when the TAM responds. Please react with :thumbsup: if you see anything missing that should be sent to AWS now.
